verdict.rationale: Unit's docs explicitly support creating deposit/wallet accounts under FBO structures for operating accounts, customer wallets, and sub-accounts, and note multi-party fund flows and real-time balances — directly matching the sub-account and per-customer account provisioning ask. However, there's no explicit mention of routing-number issuance mechanics, virtual-account-for-reconciliation patterns, or scale/bulk provisioning details, and API-level evidence (OpenAPI spec, docs endpoints) returned 404s, leaving the actual account/routing number API unverified. Missing for 10: explicit routing-number assignment details, reconciliation-specific virtual account documentation, bulk/scale provisioning evidence, and working API reference confirming account creation endpoints.
